serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Maybe we do make some noise, but it can’t be that bad! He never had a problem with it before and for sure the sound is not resonating to where he lives. 
He mentioned something about neighbors the last time, but it doesn’t make sense! Since when is he listening to what his tenants have to say? 
There must be more to this than it appears… 
You: Let me talk to the neighbor who seems to be so angry about this. I’m sure we can work something out.
#Landlord.Face.Surprised
Landlord: W-What, do you really think I will just tell you? Anonymous tip! Do you know what that is? Privacy matters around here!
Damn, he won’t make it any easier. 
You: Come on. I’m sure we can work this out.
#Landlord.Face.Grin
Landlord: Oh, for sure we can!
You: Really?! How?
Landlord: Just let me have some fun too. It doesn’t need to be every day, this body no longer has the stamina for it, but I’m sure I could still squeeze something out every now and then, buehehehe~
#Landlord.Face.Unhappy
That’s disgusting…
You: No.
Landlord: This conversation is over then! And remember! The next time I’m forced to come here I will make you pay!
